structure.title: STAMBRIDGE: Spectral-Temporal Amplitude-aware Mid-Feature Bridge for EEG Visual DecodingThanks:Citation: Jiahe Meng, Weiming Zeng, Yueyang Li, Bo Chai, Hongjie Yan, Zhiguo Zhang, Wai Ting Siok, Nizhuan Wang. STAMBRIDGE: Spectral-Temporal Amplitude-aware Mid-Feature Bridge for EEG Visual Decoding [J], IEEE Sensors Journal, 2026.
structure.abstract: AbstractThis supplementary document provides comprehensive per-subject quantitative data and extensive qualitative visual reconstruction results to support the main manuscript.
